rationale.consistency: Follows package-main layout and %w error wrapping, but re-implements discovery instead of building on gitindex.FindGitRepos and hand-rolls the index flags/largeFiles flag rather than reusing the shared cmd helpers siblings use; unconditional x/sys/unix flock makes the command unix-only.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles gitfile worktrees, bare roots, symlinked/duplicate roots, missing index dir and renamed repos; but no-root case returns a bare error rather than printing usage, a .git symlink escaping the os.Root aborts the walk, and one compound/unreadable shard aborts the whole sync.
rationale.scope: Delivers sync/list/remove/lock, but also adds a DryRun field to shared gitindex.Options, a 'sync' alias, and source-path selectors for remove; the Name-precedence flip in setTemplatesFromRepo likely alters zoekt-git-index naming (caller-set base name now beats zoekt.name/origin URL).
rationale.readability: Small, well-named functions and clear plan/apply split; minor smells: loop var shadows the imported path package, duplicated sort comparators, two identical Name/Source struct shapes.
rationale.robustness: flock with EINTR retry and errors.Join aggregation are solid; lock is only taken with -f (fine for dry runs). Weak points: any unreadable or multi-repo shard fails the entire run, shards with empty Source are silently pruned, and the gitindex name-precedence change risks regressing existing callers.
rationale.maintainability: Plan/apply separation and io.Writer plumbing ease testing, but flag definitions duplicate the cmd package, repositoryKey/repositorySpec duplicate each other, and DryRun plus the deferred Name restore add subtle coupling inside the shared indexer.
